messages:
Sam (docs): opened PR to tidy up the polaris-mini-quant model card. fixes: correct sequence limits, replace a generate->embed example, add note about quant profile compatibility. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/522

Diego (ml-infra): I'll re-run quick perf on our A10G pool. The card currently shows metrics for quant-legacy; quant-v3 is ~10% faster for short contexts. I'll post numbers and the bench command.

Sam (docs): please include the exact bench command and any non-default flags so readers can reproduce.

Rin (runtime): FYI polaris-mini-quant uses the backend fused-kv path introduced in runtime 1.16. Add compatibility note: "Runtime >=1.16 required to enable fused-kv; older runtimes will fallback to nonfused kernels with increased latency."

Maya (sdk): spotted the snippet that used text.generate for embeddings. Proposed replacements:
Python: `resp = client.embeddings.create(model=\"polaris-embed-1\", input=[\"hi\"])`
JS: `const r = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'polaris-embed-1', input: ['hi'] })`
Also suggest a one-line migration tip: "If you previously used polaris-mini-quant for embeddings via generate, switch to polaris-embed-1."

Lena (product): Can we avoid marking anything deprecated in this PR? Some enterprise customers still rely on polaris-mini-quant variants. If we recommend embed alternatives, make it advisory not prescriptive.

Sam (docs): noted. I'll keep language neutral: "Recommended: use polaris-embed-1 for embeddings."

Diego (ml-infra): Quick bench results (A10G, quant-v3): ctx 2048, batch 1 -> 1200 tok/s (old card: 1090 tok/s). Command: `bench --model polaris-mini-quant --profile quant-v3 --ctx 2048 --batch 1 --device a10g`. Logs attached in PR comments.

Rin (runtime): added runtime min version and a short note that fallback increases p95 latency ~2x. Also recommend customers pin runtime or use routing policy if they need older runtimes.

Maya (sdk): pushed the snippet patch to the docs branch. One small lint issue popped: link-bot flagged a missing anchor in the SDK guide link.

link-bot: docs/linkcheck 1: missing anchor '#embeddings-quickstart' in /sdk/guide.md

Sam (docs): thanks. I'll update the anchor and re-run CI. Once green I'll merge and request product to review messaging for customers.
